title: 1N5819HW model against its datasheet
covers: the model of the diode D1 from the 5 V rail to the module
summary: A current is forced through the diode and a reverse voltage is stepped across it. The forward voltage is compared with the maxima of the datasheet table and with its typical curve. The reverse current is read from the typical variant and from the variant whose leakage resistor is set to the maximum of the datasheet, at 4 V and at 6 V, and from the typical variant at 100 C.

notes: The forward limits are the maxima of the datasheet; the typical curve is read from a graph and the model has to lie within 10 % of it.

The reverse current is a saturation current of 4 uA plus a resistor: 1 Mohm for the typical part, 87 kohm for a part at the maximum of 50 uA at 4 V. Its rise with temperature comes from the saturation current alone.
